SUBJECTS_dragonsnake_norths_stuck.lead_html: The live Dragonsnake A-D norths are top-down dorsal views, wrong for a north facing. Three art-eval rounds of rear-view redraws (r1, r2, r3 per variant) were all judged short of ACCEPT; round 3: A, B, D really bad, C weak only on size jump vs the south (the south's own scale defect, FACING_NORMVIEW_FIX_SHRINKS_SNAKES_TO_PEAS). Pick a north per variant lane; skipping keeps the live dorsal north. Swim norths stand on your 2026-10-18 pick.

recommend.arteval_RSW_Dragonsnake__Dragonsnake_A_r: closest colour match to A's south (olive with yellow-green dorsal stripe); r3 is a drabber brown
recommend.arteval_RSW_Dragonsnake__Dragonsnake_B_r: cleanest rear view, crest and fan tail match south/east
recommend.arteval_RSW_Dragonsnake__Dragonsnake_C_r: judge WEAK only on F_SIZE_JUMP (the south's scale defect); true rear view, glow spots match
recommend.arteval_RSW_Dragonsnake__Dragonsnake_D_r: cleanest rear view, red dorsal crest matches south
